_comment: Redacted prod input for KRI-126 (job 506d2993): 30-clip guided_story whose planner fell back to deterministic beats. Media ids, paths and user ids are anonymized; durations, subjects and the degraded analysis shape are verbatim. Spoken-transcript text (stored under on_screen_text for videos) is redacted. KRI-127: each media.analysis.understanding block was regenerated from the real clips with the shared-record analyzer (scripts/dev/regen_kri126_fixture.py); transcripts and brand strings are redacted.
creator_request: Continue with 30 clips Group content by sports. Add the name of each sport to the screen. Group the pub videos together in the add and say “post match pub”. Add an intro title saying “Emir Olympics London Edition”. Group the videos from the park with individuals not playing sports the first, that is from everyone playing. Include some parts from the video where I talk to the camera and give a speech
goal: Open with title over park footage of individuals relaxing; Transition to active sports footage, grouped by sport; Include the creator's speech to camera; End with a sequence of the post-match pub celebration
